title: Explain and finish a declared-adapter Unknown observation after its provider task ends
outcome: A declared-adapter Unknown row whose provider task later reports completion retains its judged verdict while exposing a truthful completion timestamp and a useful explanation, without changing verification or native exit facts.
acceptance: A production-path control associates an Unknown declared result with ended_at absent, then supplies a terminal task notice and checks the documented completion/reason behavior while preserving the adapter outcome and evidence.

Any implementation fills only missing completion or explanation facts, preserves existing native exit/Passed/Failed/evidence associations, and does not invent verification or alter the separate unbound restart-risk policy.
